# libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(survivoR)
library(survival)
```

## Cleaning

```{r}
# processing
data(challenge_results)
data(boot_order)
data(castaways)
```

```{r}
challenge_results <- challenge_results |> 
  filter(!(season == 50) & (version == "US") & !(challenge_type == "Duel")) |>
  group_by(castaway_id, season) |>
  summarise(challenges_won = sum(won),
         individual_immunity_won = sum(won_individual_immunity),
         tribal_immunity_won = sum(won_tribal_immunity),
         tribal_reward_won = sum(won_tribal_reward),
         individual_reward_won = sum(won_individual_reward),
         .groups = "drop") 


boot_order <- boot_order |> 
  filter(!(season == 50) & (version == "US")) |>
  select(c(castaway_id, season, day, order)) |>
  distinct(season, castaway_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

castaways <- castaways |>
  filter(!(season == 50) & (version == "US")) |>
  select(c(season, castaway_id, place)) |>
  distinct(season, castaway_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
## adding back in castaways != Duel removed
us0195 <- data.frame(castaway_id = "US0195", season = 27, challenges_won = 1,
                     individual_immunity_won = 0, tribal_immunity_won = 0,
                     tribal_reward_won = 0, individual_reward_won = 0)

us0107 <- data.frame(castaway_id = "US0107", season = 27, challenges_won = 0,
                     individual_immunity_won = 0, tribal_immunity_won = 0,
                     tribal_reward_won = 0, individual_reward_won = 0)

challenge_results <- rbind(challenge_results, us0195)
challenge_results <- rbind(challenge_results, us0107)
```

# Now we merge

```{r}
join1 <- inner_join(challenge_results, boot_order, by = c("castaway_id", "season"))
# column day is day eliminated, order is order eliminated, opposite to placement
survival_data <- inner_join(join1, castaways, by = c("castaway_id", "season"))

# making colnames clearer
colnames(survival_data) <- c("castaway_id", "season", "challenges_won",
                             "individual_immunity_won", "tribal_immunity_won",
                             "tribal_reward_won", "individual_reward_one", "day_eliminated",
                             "order_eliminated", "placement")
```

## Save season 48 for testing

```{r}
season48 <- survival_data |>
  filter(season == 48)

# get rid of season 48 from combined_data
survival_data <- survival_data |>
  filter(!(season == 48))
```
